'''2011 Worlds Day 2 PMJ LS You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[PMJ]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet initials '''PMJ''' only. Line 1 Tatooine: Slave Quarters (V) → start [[You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed]]. L18 Nunbs Friends → Nien Nunb & Ten Numb. L27 Antilles Maneuver & Rebel Reinforcements (sheet Rebel Barrier). L39 Werlow → Wokling. L43 Tantive IV (V) (sheet Tatooine IV). L49 An Unlikely Flow (V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
